q.as: শুদ্ধ বিকল্পটো বাছনি কৰক: I ___ here since 2015.

explanation.en: 'Since 2015' with a state continuing up to now uses the present perfect 'have been'.
explanation.as: এতিয়ালৈকে চলি থকা অৱস্থাৰ সৈতে 'since 2015' থাকিলে present perfect 'have been' লগা হয়।

q.en: Choose the correct option: She has been ill ___ Monday.
q.as: শুদ্ধ বিকল্পটো বাছনি কৰক: She has been ill ___ Monday.

explanation.en: 'Since' is used with a point of time (Monday) in perfect tenses.
explanation.as: Perfect tense ত সময়ৰ এটা বিন্দু (Monday) ৰ সৈতে 'since' ব্যৱহাৰ হয়।

q.en: Choose the correct option: I have lived here ___ ten years.
q.as: শুদ্ধ বিকল্পটো বাছনি কৰক: I have lived here ___ ten years.

explanation.en: 'For' is used with a period of time (ten years) in perfect tenses.
explanation.as: Perfect tense ত সময়ৰ এটা কালছোৱা (ten years) ৰ সৈতে 'for' ব্যৱহাৰ হয়।

q.en: Choose the correct option: He ___ already left when I called him.
q.as: শুদ্ধ বিকল্পটো বাছনি কৰক: He ___ already left when I called him.

explanation.en: The earlier of two past actions uses the past perfect 'had left'.
explanation.as: অতীতৰ দুটা কামৰ আগৰটো past perfect 'had left' ৰে প্ৰকাশ কৰা হয়।

q.en: Choose the correct option: If it ___ tomorrow, we will cancel the picnic.
q.as: শুদ্ধ বিকল্পটো বাছনি কৰক: If it ___ tomorrow, we will cancel the picnic.

explanation.en: In a first conditional, the 'if' clause uses the simple present, not 'will'.
explanation.as: First conditional ত 'if' খণ্ডত simple present ব্যৱহাৰ হয়, 'will' নহয়।

q.en: Choose the correct option: She will call you when she ___ .
q.as: শুদ্ধ বিকল্পটো বাছনি কৰক: She will call you when she ___ .

explanation.en: After 'when' referring to the future, the simple present is used.
explanation.as: ভৱিষ্যত বুজোৱা 'when' ৰ পিছত simple present ব্যৱহাৰ হয়।

q.en: Choose the correct option: He said that he ___ the work the next day.
q.as: শুদ্ধ বিকল্পটো বাছনি কৰক: He said that he ___ the work the next day.

explanation.en: In indirect speech, 'will' becomes 'would'.
explanation.as: পৰোক্ষ উক্তিত 'will' ৰ পৰিৱৰ্তন 'would' হয়।

q.en: Choose the correct option: They ___ here since morning.
q.as: শুদ্ধ বিকল্পটো বাছনি কৰক: They ___ here since morning.

explanation.en: 'Since morning' for a state continuing to the present uses the present perfect 'have been'.
explanation.as: বৰ্তমানলৈকে চলি থকা অৱস্থাৰ সৈতে 'since morning' থাকিলে present perfect 'have been' লগা হয়।
